recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-16685 unless a future Patient Care decision changes the intended relationship between CarePlan.created and workflow Request.authoredOn.
issue_request: FHIR-16685 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care STU3 issue asking that CarePlan include the time and date it was created. The accepted resolution was to add CarePlan.created dateTime 0..1 with the definition that it represents when this particular CarePlan record was created in the system, often as a system-generated date.
initial_application: Git commit f235b25c5ef0e84d57ea366f811fa801f1db9a25, dated 2018-07-03, explicitly says "GF#16685 CarePlan.created added" and added the historical CarePlan.created spreadsheet row plus a created value in the main CarePlan example.
additional_context: CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml retains CarePlan.created with the GF#16685 note, 0..1 cardinality, dateTime type, accepted short and definition, and isSummary=true. The Request mapping exception file records the deliberate distinction from Request.authoredOn. Patient Care Confluence minutes list GF#16685 in the 2018 CarePlan tracker discussion/resolved context. FHIR-38809 was found as a later CarePlan invariant text correction, but it does not affect CarePlan.created.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active CarePlan source and supporting artifacts already implement the final Jira resolution. Additional prose would be redundant and would not change implementer understanding.
